instruction: The last Venmo payment request I sent to Robert was an accident and they approved it. Send them the money back.
notes: Two-app lookup chain: supervisor.show_profile yields the phone number (phone username) and email (venmo username); phone.search_contacts resolves Robert's email; venmo.show_sent_payment_requests (status=approved) filtered by Robert's email yields the latest accidental request and its amount; venmo.create_transaction refunds exactly that amount to that email with a description note. Hidden static facts (email-of, last-approved-request, request-amount) model entities that exist but whose values are only known after the lookup actions. The (not (refunded ...)) precondition ensures exactly one transaction is created, matching the evaluation (one added venmo.Transaction, only venmo_balance changed on users). supervisor-complete-task carries the task-record parameters (request, person, amount) which are not API arguments; the task asks no question so no answer is passed.
